title: orch focus ticket data: ext.focus
description: Owned by the focus add-on (its ticket_ext; the add-on ships a byte-identical copy). The core never reads it. Written once by Focus when it starts a run for the ticket, so the ticket page can show an 'Open live page' row (ticket_view format open-page: [page] path + '/' + page).

page.description: Path of the ticket's live page on Focus's own page: t/<ticket id>.
